pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng mǎi nà bǎ zhéchǐ , yǐjīng xiǎng le sāntiān .
pairs.english: Tavi had wanted that folding ruler for three days.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想买那把折尺，已经想了三天。

pairs.target: tā bǎizài tiě huò pù ménkǒu , hé qǐlái hái méi tā shǒuzhǎng cháng , zhǎnkāi què bǐ zìjǐ nà kuài báobǎn cháng chū hǎoxiē , biānshàng kèxiàn xì dé xiàng yìpái zhàn qí de xiǎorén .
pairs.english: At the ironmonger's door, it folded shorter than his palm but opened much longer than his thin board, its fine graduations like little people lined up neatly.
pairs.hanzi: 它摆在铁货铺门口，合起来还没他手掌长，展开却比自己那块薄板长出好些，边上刻线细得像一排站齐的小人。

pairs.target: jīnrì qù lǐng dìyīduàn gōngqián , tā gùyì rào nàbiān zǒu , xiǎngzhe zhī kàn yìyǎn , màihuò de què rènde tā , gé lǎoyuǎn jiù jiāng chǐ ná chūlái .
pairs.english: Going for his first pay installment today, he deliberately passed that way for one look, but the seller recognized him and brought the ruler out from afar.
pairs.hanzi: 今日去领第一段工钱，他故意绕那边走，想着只看一眼，卖货的却认得他，隔老远就将尺拿出来。

pairs.target: " zài kàn , qī dōu yào ràng nǐ kàn báo le . "
pairs.english: “Keep looking and you'll wear the paint thin.”
pairs.hanzi: “再看，漆都要让你看薄了。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò , kāihé liǎnghuí , zhēn wènqǐ jiàqián .
pairs.english: Tavi took it, opened and closed it twice, and finally asked the price.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过，开合两回，真问起价钱。

pairs.target: diànjiā bào wán , tā shǒuzhǐ tíng zài jiǎo tóu páng , xiǎngqǐ hé kàn hòu hái dé yòngqián ; jiè gōngjù zuòhuó shì yì huíshì , xiǎng yán zìjǐ xuǎn de lù chūqù , yòu shì lìngyìhuíshì .
pairs.english: At the quoted price his fingers paused by the hinge. He remembered needing money after review: borrowed tools for work were one thing, setting out on his own chosen road another.
pairs.hanzi: 店家报完，他手指停在铰头旁，想起核看后还得用钱；借工具做活是一回事，想沿自己选的路出去，又是另一回事。

pairs.target: fàn hé zhùchù zhào yuánlái yuē hǎo de gěi , zhè yì xiǎodài gōngqián búyòng quán ná qù dǐ , què yě bùquánshì néng dāngrì huāwán de .
pairs.english: Food and lodging were provided as agreed, so this little pay bag did not all go toward them, but neither could it all be spent today.
pairs.hanzi: 饭和住处照原来约好的给，这一小袋工钱不用全拿去抵，却也不全是能当日花完的。

pairs.target: tā ràng diànjiā xiān shōuhuí , pángbiān yǒu gè gǎnjí de nǚrén lìkè lái wèn , néng bunéng piányi xiē názǒu .
pairs.english: He let the seller put it away, and a market-going woman immediately asked to buy it cheaper.
pairs.hanzi: 他让店家先收回，旁边有个赶集的女人立刻来问，能不能便宜些拿走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běnlái yǐ zhuǎnshēn , yòu huíguò tóu , tīngjiàn zìjǐ shuō , xiān bié mài , zìjǐ hái méi shuō búyào .
pairs.english: Tavi had already turned away, then looked back and heard himself say not to sell it yet: he had not said no.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本来已转身，又回过头，听见自己说，先别卖，自己还没说不要。

pairs.target: diànjiā kànkàn tā , yòu kànkàn nǚrén , xiào dào nà nǐ dé shuō yào , bùrán háiyào zìjǐ tì tā cáng dào qiūtiān ?
pairs.english: The seller looked between them and laughed: then say yes, or must he keep it hidden until autumn?
pairs.hanzi: 店家看看他，又看看女人，笑道那你得说要，不然还要自己替他藏到秋天？

pairs.target: tǎ wéi liǎnshàng yǒuxiē rè , qǔchū qián shù guò , zuìhòu háishì mǎi le . chǐ chuāi jìn yī nèi , zǒu chūqù yíduàn , tā réng rěnbúzhù gé zhe bù mō yi mō , xiàng pà nà diǎn báo mù hūrán yòu huí le pù lǐ .
pairs.english: Warm-faced, Tavi counted his money and bought it after all. Walking away with it inside his clothes, he kept feeling through the cloth, fearing the thin wood might suddenly return to the shop.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维脸上有些热，取出钱数过，最后还是买了。尺揣进衣内，走出去一段，他仍忍不住隔着布摸一摸，像怕那点薄木忽然又回了铺里。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zài mǎi gěi zìjǐ kàn de dōngxī . sè lā yòng de zhēn , zhēnyǎn dà xiē de lìng bāo yìxiǎo shù ,
pairs.english: He bought nothing more for himself. A little bundle of larger-eyed needles was wrapped separately for Sela,
pairs.hanzi: 他没有再买给自己看的东西。瑟拉用的针，针眼大些的另包一小束，

pairs.target: gěi pà wò de shì liǎngpiàn báo mù hé yì jié yìng xiàn , tuōluó dí xiāoguò biān , tā xiǎngzhe yěxǔ néng ràng láng zuǐ hé shàng shí duō liē yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: and Pavo would get two thin wooden pieces and stiff wire, edges shaved by Luodi, which Tavi hoped might make the wolf grin wider when its jaws closed.
pairs.hanzi: 给帕沃的是两片薄木和一截硬线，托罗荻削过边，他想着也许能让狼嘴合上时多咧一点。

pairs.target: mǐlā hé yīwén de dōngxī bùnéng tì tāmen hú mǎi , tā zhī tiāo le bàndài nài fàng de kǎo dòu , lìng yào yìzhāng néng bāo dé zhù de zhǐ .
pairs.english: He would not choose random things for Mira and Iven, only half a bag of keeping-quality roasted beans and sturdy wrapping paper.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉和伊文的东西不能替他们胡买，他只挑了半袋耐放的烤豆，另要一张能包得住的纸。

pairs.target: huí yuànlǐ , ā xún zhèng shōu nà zuò guǒ xiāng qiáo , jiàn tā xīn chǐ , shēnshǒu yào kàn .
pairs.english: Back in the yard, Axun was packing the crate bridge; seeing the new ruler, he reached to inspect it.
pairs.hanzi: 回院里，阿荀正收那座果箱桥，见他新尺，伸手要看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dìguòqù , duìfāng yì zhǎnkāi biàn tàn le yìshēng , shuō hé lù suǒ zěnme méi gěi zìjǐ yě fā yìbǎ .
pairs.english: Tavi handed it over. Unfolding it, Axun sighed and asked why the Joint Routes Office had not issued him one too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维递过去，对方一展开便叹了一声，说合路所怎么没给自己也发一把。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gǎnjǐn shuō zìjǐ mǎi de , ā xún xiào tā bào dé nàme jǐn , shuí hái zhēn huì názǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi hastily said he had bought it. Axun teased his tight grip: who would really take it away?
pairs.hanzi: 塔维赶紧说自己买的，阿荀笑他抱得那么紧，谁还真会拿走。

pairs.target: zhè rì de huó bìng méi yīnwèi tā míngzǎo zǒu jiù biàn shǎo .
pairs.english: His leaving tomorrow morning did not reduce today's work.
pairs.hanzi: 这日的活并没因为他明早走就变少。

pairs.target: yù hé náchū jǐzhāng yuángǎo , jiào tā fēnqīng nǎxiē liú xiànchǎng , nǎxiē dài hé kàn , bùnéng bǎ níng qí de cèdiǎn yuánjiàn quánjuàn huí bái jiē .
pairs.english: Yuhe produced originals and told him to separate those staying on site from those for review, not carry all Ningqi's measuring originals to White Steps.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾拿出几张原稿，叫他分清哪些留现场、哪些带核看，不能把宁岐的测点原件全卷回白阶。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zìjǐ de liànxí zhǐ fàng yìbiān , chāo tú tóng láiyuán fù zài yìqǐ , lìng jiāng nà zhāng lòu xiàn de " dài hé " zhǐ fàngjìn zìjǐ de jiá lǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi set practice papers aside, attached sources to copied drawings, and put the omitted-line sheet marked “unverified” in his own folder.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将自己的练习纸放一边，抄图同来源附在一起，另将那张漏线的“待核”纸放进自己的夹里。

pairs.target: kànjiàn nà yìzhāng , níng qí jiàozhù tā , shuō kěyǐ dài qù , bié zhī dài gǎi hǎo de .
pairs.english: Seeing it, Ningqi stopped him: take that too, not only corrected work.
pairs.hanzi: 看见那一张，宁岐叫住他，说可以带去，别只带改好的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , xīnlǐ què bǐ qián xiē rìzi bú nàme pà biérén kànjiàn tā .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, less afraid than before of others seeing it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，心里却比前些日子不那么怕别人看见它。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng wèn lǎoshī de yǐjīng bù zhǐshì nǎ yì gé shù suàncuò , háiyǒu wèishénme yǒu de biān zhàn zài gēnqián yě huì kànbújiàn .
pairs.english: His questions for teachers were no longer only which figure was wrong, but why even a nearby edge could remain unseen.
pairs.hanzi: 他想问老师的已经不只是哪一格数算错，还有为什么有的边站在跟前也会看不见。

pairs.target: xiàwǔ shōu gōngjù , jiù chǐ hái huí jiàshàng , zìjǐ de xīn chǐ liúzài yī nèi .
pairs.english: Packing tools that afternoon, he returned the old ruler to the rack and kept his own inside his clothes.
pairs.hanzi: 下午收工具，旧尺还回架上，自己的新尺留在衣内。

pairs.target: yù hé niēqǐ tā huà de māo , shuō zhè zhāng jì búshì cèdiǎn , yě búshì láiyuán , zěnme hùn dào gōngshì lǐ .
pairs.english: Yuhe held up his cat drawing and asked how something neither a measuring point nor a source had crept into official work.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾捏起他画的猫，说这张既不是测点，也不是来源，怎么混到公事里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yìbǎ chōu huílái , zhèngyào jiěshì , tīngjiàn tā xiào , cái zhīdào yòu shàngdàng le .
pairs.english: Tavi snatched it back and began to explain, then heard her laugh and knew he had fallen for it again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维一把抽回来，正要解释，听见她笑，才知道又上当了。

pairs.target: luó dí láishí dài zhe nà piàn gāng biān hǎo de cǎodiàn . zhēnjiǎo bú tài qí , zuòxià qù què méi xiǎngxiàng zhōng chuō .
pairs.english: Luodi arrived with the newly woven grass pad. Its stitches were uneven, but sitting on it was less prickly than expected.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻来时带着那片刚编好的草垫。针脚不太齐，坐下去却没想象中戳。

pairs.target: tā jiào tǎ wéi shì , zìjǐ zài pángbiān dīng zhe , kàn tā dòng le yíxià , lìkè wèn nǎ yìbiān gè .
pairs.english: He watched Tavi try it and immediately asked which side hurt when he shifted.
pairs.hanzi: 他叫塔维试，自己在旁边盯着，看他动了一下，立刻问哪一边硌。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō kùzǐ dǐxià yǒu gè jié , búshì cǎodiàn , luó dí jiāng tā gǎnqǐlái , shuō bié bǎ zìjǐ de máobìng quán lài gěi biérén xīn zuò de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Tavi said there was a knot under his trousers, not the pad. Luodi chased him up: don't blame your own problems on someone else's new work.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说裤子底下有个结，不是草垫，罗荻将他赶起来，说别把自己的毛病全赖给别人新做的东西。

pairs.target: línhé nà jiān pùzi méi zūchéng . tángxiōng tóng zào biān nǚrén qùguò , guō guǒrán bǎibúxià , hòutou zhǔfàn hái dé jiè rénjiā de yán .
pairs.english: The riverside shop was not rented. His cousin and the cook had visited; the pot truly would not fit, and cooking meant borrowing someone else's eaves.
pairs.hanzi: 临河那间铺子没租成。堂兄同灶边女人去过，锅果然摆不下，后头煮饭还得借人家的檐。

pairs.target: yǎnxià xiān zài jiù yuàn tiān bànjié dǐngpéng , luó dí shuō děng tǎ wéi zài lái , duōbàn kànjiàn ménkǒu nà duī mùtou zhōngyú bù línyǔ le .
pairs.english: For now they would add half an awning in the old yard; Luodi said next visit, Tavi would probably see the woodpile finally out of the rain.
pairs.hanzi: 眼下先在旧院添半截顶棚，罗荻说等塔维再来，多半看见门口那堆木头终于不淋雨了。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén dōu méi shuō yídìng nǎ tiān zài lái .
pairs.english: Neither promised a particular return date.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人都没说一定哪天再来。

pairs.target: luó dí bǎ yíduàn duǎnshéng sāi gěi tā , shì xīn huàn guòtóu de , shuō lùshang ruò yǒurén bǐ jié , biéshū dé ràng rén yǐwéi zhé tóng zhī huì dǎsǐ kòu .
pairs.english: Luodi gave him short rope with newly finished ends: if anyone raced knots on the road, don't lose so badly they thought Zhetong only made jammed knots.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻把一段短绳塞给他，是新换过头的，说路上若有人比结，别输得让人以为折桐只会打死扣。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi tuīhuíqù , wèn tā xìn wǎng nǎér jì , luó dí bào le tángxiōng de ménqián pù hào , yòu jiào tā xiě shōuxìnrén de míngzì , bié gěi zhěnggè yuànzi jì yìfēng " nàge huì xiūchē de rén ".
pairs.english: Tavi accepted and asked where to send letters. Luodi gave his cousin's shop number and said to name the recipient, not address the whole yard as “the one who repairs carts.”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没推回去，问他信往哪儿寄，罗荻报了堂兄的门前铺号，又叫他写收信人的名字，别给整个院子寄一封“那个会修车的人”。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn kàn lù nǚrén lái zhǎo shū yàn jiāo pái , tǎ wéi cái zhīdào tāmen lìng jiē le jiēxiàlái wǔ zǎo de huó , réng àn shíjì lái chē pái , bú jiè zǒu záhuòpù .
pairs.english: That evening the passage woman handed her sign to Shuyan. Tavi learned they had another five mornings booked, still scheduling actual carts without taking over the shop.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚看路女人来找舒砚交牌，塔维才知道他们另接了接下来五早的活，仍按实际来车排，不借走杂货铺。

pairs.target: rén hé chē zhàojiù yǒu bàoyuàn , yuǎn búshì yíjù shì bànchéng le .
pairs.english: People and drivers still complained; this was far from declaring the job done.
pairs.hanzi: 人和车照旧有抱怨，远不是一句事办成了。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài láng xià tīng le yíhuìer , děng shēngyīn jiànjiàn yí dào yuàn wài , cái huíqù bǎ zhéchǐ ná chūlái , rènrènzhēnzhēn zài zhǐ shàng huà le dìyītiáo zhī shǔyú zìjǐ de zhíxiàn .
pairs.english: He listened under the gallery, then as the voices drifted outside, returned and carefully drew the first straight line with his very own folding ruler.
pairs.hanzi: 他站在廊下听了一会儿，等声音渐渐移到院外，才回去把折尺拿出来，认认真真在纸上画了第一条只属于自己的直线。
